title: Add Relationship evidence validation reason diagnostics
purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
Temporary diagnostics only. No Relationship processing behavior change.

Adds a reason label when parseEvidence() rejects Analyzer output, without logging any field values or conversation content.

Possible labels include invalid_polarity, supporting_not_user_substring, duplicate_candidate, etc.

No API keys, prompts, replies, evidence payloads, DB contents, lease tokens, or user data are logged.
